watch.label: The Star Packer (1934) on the Internet Archive

editorial:
The Star Packer is a 1934 B-western directed by Robert N. Bradbury. The Internet Archive item lists a US release date of 30 July 1934 and Paul Malvern Productions as the production company. Its description reads: a gang working for The Shadow is terrorizing the town, and John Travers decides to take on the job of sheriff and do something about it.

The rights trap is the renewal. A 1934 film's copyright had to be renewed in its 28th year, which falls in 1961-62. The renewal check is not complete. The cited 1962 Catalog of Copyright Entries volume is not enough on its own, other renewal-year volumes were not verified here, and the original registration was not located. Until a complete check is done, treat the print as unconfirmed. Names and likenesses of performers are a separate right. The Internet Archive copy is a user upload, so source and quality may vary.
faq: Is The Star Packer public domain?
Not confirmed. No complete renewal check has been done, and the 1934 registration was not located. Complete the check of the renewal-year Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes before relying on it.
Can I use the Internet Archive copy?

Check the upload you use. User uploads vary in source and quality, so read the upload's own description. The print status is also still undetermined. Performers' names and likenesses are a separate matter.
